snippet.title: Lost Land Adventure (trailer)
snippet.description: New lightgun shooting game from Bandai Namco Games coming in Summer 2014 in Japan and later worldwide. The machine is equipped with a spherical screen. As in Deadstrom Pirates and Dark Escape 3D, combined fire is more powerful and guns don't need to be reloaded.
